title: Proceedings Tenth Symposium on Working Formal Methods
abstract: arXiv:2609.30324v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The 10th Working Formal Methods Symposium (FROM 2026) was held in Timi\c{s}oara, Romania on September 15-17, 2026. It was organized jointly by the Faculty of Informatics of West University of Timi\c{s}oara, the e-Austria institute, and the Institute for Logic and Data Science (ILDS). This event was co-located with the 28th International Symposium on Symbolic and Numeric Algorithms for Scientific Computing (SYNASC 2026). This volume contains the texts of  the 14 papers accepted by the Program Committee for presentation.

translated_title: 第十届形式化方法工作研讨会论文集
translated_abstract: 第十届形式化方法工作研讨会（FROM 2026）于2026年9月15日至17日在罗马尼亚蒂米什瓦拉举行。该会议由蒂米什瓦拉西部大学信息学院、e-奥地利研究所以及逻辑与数据科学研究所（ILDS）联合举办，并与第28届科学计算符号与数值算法国际研讨会（SYNASC 2026）同期举行。本论文集收录了程序委员会录用的14篇论文的全文。
tldr: 该论文集收录了2026年在罗马尼亚蒂米什瓦拉举行的第十届形式化方法工作研讨会（FROM 2026）经程序委员会评审录用的14篇论文。
en_tdlr: This volume contains the 14 papers accepted by the Program Committee for presentation at the 10th Working Formal Methods Symposium (FROM 2026), held in Timișoara, Romania.
